name: Restore approved Supabase row updates with HTTP Request

nodes.name: Claim approved job
nodes.notes: Choose a Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_WORKER_KEY. Use the same credential on Report outcome.

nodes.name: Read current resource
nodes.notes: Header Auth: apikey = a server-side Supabase sb_secret key. Keep this credential only in n8n. Secret keys bypass RLS; use the dedicated test project first.

nodes.name: Conditional restore
nodes.notes: Same Supabase apikey credential as Read current resource. The installed RPC locks and checks the row in one transaction. Never enable write retries.

nodes.name: Report outcome
nodes.notes: Use your Rewind WORKER key. Retrying this exact result report is safe. Do not rerun the provider write to retry reporting.

parameters.content:
### How it works
This worker is for n8n builders who have already captured a supported Supabase row update with Rewind. It claims one approved recovery job for the configured connection, reads the row and compares the current revision with the recorded result. If it still matches, the connector restores the original fields in a conditional transaction. A later edit stops recovery and preserves current data.

The workflow reports the outcome to Rewind. A report is not independent verification: inspect the actual Supabase row afterward. Capture and human approval happen separately; this worker cannot recover changes recorded after the fact or approve its own work.

### Setup
Use a dedicated development project with the connector and disposable demo table from https://rewind.kanishq.dev/#connect. Configure the Rewind and Supabase origins and the same connection name used by capture. Select Rewind worker Header Auth on Claim approved job and Report outcome. Select Supabase apikey Header Auth on Read current resource and Conditional restore. Credentials are not included.

Keep the workflow inactive. Capture one update, approve it in Rewind, then use Run once. Verify active/5 is restored. Repeat with a fresh captured update followed by a later edit and require that edit to remain. Publish the schedule only after both checks pass.

### Customization
Use only registered rows and supported scalar updates. No inserts, deletes or trigger-side-effect rollback. Inspect unknown outcomes manually; do not repeat an uncertain restore.

### Start and route approved work
Keep inactive for the first drill. Run once claims an already approved job for this connection; it does not approve recovery. Select the worker credential on claim and report nodes.

### Check current state
Read the provider with Supabase credentials. Compare row revision and recorded values. The false branch reports a conflict without restoring.

### Restore and report
Restore only when the condition still matches. Report the result, then independently inspect the Supabase row. An uncertain write must not be retried automatically.
